name: doodad-snap-custom-flags
description: Snap Doodads on Load, the cases the other snap specs leave out (test.md), on doodad-snap-custom-misc.w3x (fixtures/we-specs/make-doodad-snap.mjs misc): custom doodads on 2x2Default and 4x4Default placed with flags 0 and 1 as well as 2, each off its grid at two angles: they snap as with flags 2 in both editors (2026-11-14, two runs). The missing texture's entries (doodads 0-5 and 18-19) are doodad-snap-custom-missing's

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); window.__driveEd.pushEdit({ undo() {}, redo() {}, terrain: false, objects: false });

name: doodad-snap-custom-missing
description: the same map: a custom doodad (D300, flags 2, 0 and 1) and a custom destructable (B300) whose pathing texture the map names but doesn't have (Custom\own-missing4.tga). The editor leaves them where they stand, angle and place (2026-11-14, two runs; doodads[0]: -1486.5, 521.25, angle 0.4; the destructables keep theirs, not their type's fixed rotation), and so does Studio (doodadgrid.ts snapSize: no snap size when the type's own texture stands in)
